verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page repeatedly states that IP allowlisting keeps code accessible only to authorized users, which directly matches the story of restricting organization code access to an allowlist. The evidence is only a marketing-level claim, with no setup docs and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring the allowlist, scope of enforcement (web UI vs. Git/SSH vs. API), plan-tier requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.
